claims.exact_statement: For every descendant-critical Boolean f on N uniform physical bits with R=H(f)/I(f), every block A of size a, and every tensor T=u(x_A)h(x_{A^c}) at Hamming distance epsilon<=1/16 from f, R(I(u)-2a epsilon) <= H(u)+2 h_2(2 sqrt(epsilon))+(2N-a)2 sqrt(epsilon). Consequently, if R>4 then f is farther than 1/(2^18 N^2) from every tensor carrying the six-bit one-point-defect factor; the one-point-surgery family phi^{tensor m} with one flipped truth-table value is therefore not descendant-critical with H/I>4 for m>=5.
